# anthropic_plugin_versions (Data Source)

Beta. Lists the stored versions of a Claude Enterprise plugin (`GET /v1/organizations/plugins/{id}/versions`). Available to Claude Enterprise organizations only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_plugin_versions" "example" {
  plugin_id = "plugin_01EXAMPLE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plugin_id` (String) ID of the plugin (`plugin_...`).

### Read-Only

- `versions` (Attributes List) Versions of the plugin. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `components` (Attributes List) What the version contains. Null when not enumerated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions--components))
- `content_scan` (Attributes) Content scan of the version. Null when not scanned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions--content_scan))
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the version was stored.
- `description` (String) Description from the manifest. Null when none.
- `display_name` (String) Display name from the manifest. Null when none.
- `id` (String) ID of the version (`pluginver_...`).
- `manifest_version` (String) Manifest `version`, normalized for display. May be null.
- `reach` (String) `contained`, `privileged` or `remote`. Null when not classified.
- `release_notes` (String) Release notes supplied with the upload. Null when none.

<a id="nestedatt--versions--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions.components`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) What the component declares about itself. Null for MCP servers, hooks and CLIs.
- `name` (String) Name of the skill, command, agent, MCP server key, hook event or CLI executable.
- `type` (String) `agent`, `cli`, `command`, `hook`, `mcp_server` or `skill`.


<a id="nestedatt--versions--content_scan"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions.content_scan`

Read-Only:

- `assessment` (String) `pass`, `warn`, `fail` or `unknown`. Set only when `status` is `completed`.
- `reason` (String) Main mechanism behind a `warn` or `fail`. Null otherwise.
- `status` (String) `processing`, `completed` or `errored`.
